children: "Uncertainty was the story last year, but now it seems to have become the new baseline. Business leaders say they can't afford to wait for certainty any longer."
-Tom Barkin, president of the Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond, discussing the timing of the Fed's decision to raise interest rates in prepared remarks.
